## Write a root in index form {#root-form}

Read the root from the radical sign and the power from the expression inside. Keep the coefficient outside.

:::::: {.example-pair}

::::: {.model}

<h3>Worked example</h3>

$5\sqrt[3]{x^2}$

::: {.fragment}

[The cube root gives a denominator of 3.]{.annotation}

$=5(x^2)^{\frac13}$

:::

::: {.fragment}

[Multiply the indices. The coefficient stays 5.]{.annotation}

$=5x^{2\times\frac13}=5x^{\frac23}$

:::

:::::

::::: {.paper}

::: {.fragment}

<h3>Your turn</h3>

$5\sqrt[4]{x^2}$

Only the root changes. Write the expression in index form and simplify the index.

:::

::: {.fragment}

[Check your working]{.annotation}

$=5(x^2)^{\frac14}$

$=5x^{\frac24}=5x^{\frac12}$

:::
